title: Solutions Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><div><span id="m_8220454926977230902gmail-docs-internal-guid-9a9f34f4-7fff-014a-c97c-98ca90610a47">Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.</span></div> <div> </div></div><p>We are looking for experienced, curious, and driven Solutions Engineers to help customers realise the full value of our platform in a fast-growing market.</p> <p>This role is a critical part of Algolia’s go-to-market organisation, working closely with Sales and Solutions partners to drive revenue, customer adoption, and best practices. You will play a key role in helping prospects and customers evaluate Algolia, understand its technical capabilities, and successfully apply it to their use cases.</p> <p>In this position, you will own the technical pre-sales relationship across opportunities and accounts. You will partner with Account Executives to demonstrate the product and underlying architecture, address technical and business objections, and deliver thoughtful, consultative solutions that result in a strong technical win and clear product fit.</p> <p>You will act as both a deep technical expert and a trusted advisor. This means being equally comfortable presenting an engaging solution to a CTO, collaborating with product managers, or building prototypes and integrations directly with customer engineers using Algolia’s APIs.</p> <p>You thrive in conversations with engineers, product leaders, and executives, and you know how to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for diverse audiences.</p> <p>Beyond customer-facing work, you will serve as an advocate for customer needs internally, partnering with Product and Engineering, contributing to technical content, enabling internal teams, and supporting cross-company initiatives that improve how customers succeed with Algolia.</p> <p>Our priorities are guided by a simple question: what will help our customers be more successful with Algolia?</p> <h3>YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:</h3> <ul> <li>Work with Sales Teams and prospects on their evaluation and adoption of Algolia solutions</li> <li>Understand and qualify customer goals with KPIs and effectively articulate Algolia’s ability to meet them</li> <li>Assist in the Sales process including discovery, demo, Proofs of Concept (POC), RFP responses & business justification</li> <li>Develop custom search applications leveraging the tools, frameworks, and partners of the Algolia ecosystem.</li> <li>Distill and advocate customer interests, needs and product feedback in order to relay to Product and Engineering teams</li> <li>Continuously learn and update skills and keep aware of industry trends in the Search and Discovery space, and contribute to thought leadership to make Algolia more accessible to the world.</li> <li>Work with the Solution Architects and Customer Success teams on seamless transition to the post sales process to ensure highly successful onboarding</li> </ul> <h3>YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:</h3> <ul> <li>Obsessed with Solving Customer Problems</li> <li>3+ years experience in a customer-facing technical role (SE, SA, consultant, PM), ideally in the SaaS space</li> <li>Proven solutions engineering skills: value selling, objection handling, running a sales process and working with Account Executives</li> <li>Previous software development experience in one or more of the following areas:<br>Front End: JavaScript, TypeScript, React<br>Back-End: Java, Ruby, Go, Node, Python, Swift/Objective-C</li> <li>Experience with data formats and data transformation</li> <li>Great oral and written communication skills</li> <li>Superior organisational skills working with multiple customers and have the ability to switch context quickly throughout the day with various competing demands and attention to detail</li> </ul> <p>NICE TO HAVE:</p> <ul> <li>Additional European languages such as Spanish</li> <li>A background in the search industry or e-commerce</li> <li>Specific knowledge in frameworks Magento, Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, commercetools and alike</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging concepts in agentic AI systems (e.g., autonomous reasoning, tool use, or multi-agent orchestration).</li> <li>Knowledge in Analytics, SEO</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.</p></div><div class="title">On-Target Earnings Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£78,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£129,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:</strong></p> <p>Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. </p> <p>We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees.<strong> Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.</strong></p> <p><strong>WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>GRIT</strong> - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.</li> <li><strong>TRUST </strong>- Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.</li> <li><strong>CANDOR</strong> - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.</li> <li><strong>CARE</strong> - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.</li> <li><strong>HUMILITY</strong> - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.</li> </ul> <p>We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.</p> <p><strong>IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice</strong></p> <p>We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an ----- email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.</li> <li>We’ll <strong>never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details</strong> during the hiring process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>READY TO APPLY?</strong></p> <p>If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. Success means connecting visibility to pipeline and revenue, not traffic alone. Snowflake, Databricks, Vertex AI, AWS Sagemaker).</li> <li>Experience moving to <strong>modern data architecture</strong> environment, with Deep Datawarehouse/lakehouse (AWS Redshift, Databricks), streaming/batch, APIs, data products, ELT, CDC, structured + unstructured data experience.</li> <li>Proven experience with <strong>AI/ML engineering</strong> and success deploying ML models into production, feature engineering, model serving, monitoring, MLOps.</li> <li>Exceptional ability to translate complex agentic systems, context-engineering strategies, and distributed database details into clear, business-relevant narratives for non-technical and executive boards.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>THE POSITION</strong></p> <p>Our roster has an opening with your name on it</p> <p>Much of what decides whether a fan stays with FanDuel happens either side of the bet: the sign-up that takes a minute, the deposit that clears first time on a Sunday afternoon, the withdrawal that lands when we said it would, and the protections that work quietly in the background for the people who need them.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to shape the technical direction of the systems behind that experience across FanDuel’s Customer Product Engineering (CPE) domain.</p> <p>CPE builds the systems fans touch first and trust most: payments and money movement, account and onboarding, geolocation, responsible gaming and player integrity, and the promotions, rewards and loyalty, campaign orchestration, personalisation and marketing messaging that shape every fan’s day-to-day experience. When CPE works, nobody notices. When it does not, a fan cannot get in, get funded, get paid or get looked after, and quality elsewhere in the product does not make up for it.</p> <p>The mission: make it quick and predictable for every fan to join, fund an account, get paid and be protected, in every jurisdiction we operate in, on the busiest day of the sporting calendar. Making every moment more, for our customers. Your work always follows our principle <em>Everything Begins with the Customer.</em></p> <p>That means designing for extreme, event-driven peak load, where traffic arrives in seconds, and for a heavily regulated environment in which auditability and evidence matter as much as availability. It also means depending on other people’s systems: payment providers, identity and KYC vendors, geolocation suppliers. You build so that their bad day does not become our customers’ bad day.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role, at the same level as our Software Engineering Directors. You will own the technical strategy for a major part of CPE over a multi-year horizon, working alongside Directors and senior Product partners to work out what we build and what we stop. You will take on the questions with no obviously correct answer: where a capability belongs, which systems to retire, how money moves safely across providers, how to prove compliance without slowing delivery. A lot of this will not have been done here before, so a large part of the work is finding out what is true before the organisation commits to it.</p> <p>You are close to the code in your day-to-day, but most of your impact comes through other engineers: shaping designs, working the hardest incidents with the people closest to them, and growing the engineers moving into Staff and Senior Staff roles. You can trace a fan’s experience back through the stack to the decision that caused it, and you can explain a technical trade-off to an executive audience without diluting it.</p> <p>You are candid about what is not working, you seek out views that differ from your own, and when a call needs making you make it and help others get behind it, <em>Challenge and Commit.</em> You wear your FanDuel hat first and do not restrict yourself to organisational boundaries, <em>We are One Team.</em> You are a visible part of the domain leadership team and of our senior engineering community, and a role model to the wider engineering organisation, <em>Humble and Hungry.</em></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>THE GAME PLAN</strong><br>Everyone on our team has a part to play</p> <ul> <li>Own the long-term technical strategy for your area of CPE, aligning the architecture of several teams with wider FanDuel initiatives and with the scale the business is heading towards.</li> <li>Start from the customer outcome and work back: registration and verification completion, time to first bet, deposit and withdrawal success rates, payout speed, geolocation pass rates, and the availability of whole journeys rather than the uptime of single services. Make sure our systems can measure these, and create new ways to measure and communicate customer impact where today’s fall short.</li> <li>Make the technical choices that have sweeping consequences across the domain, design the systems they call for in stages rather than as a single large bet, and bring engineers, managers and product partners with you.</li> <li>Architect for extreme, event-driven peak load and for third-party failure, so that capacity, failover and degradation behaviour are proven before the biggest days in the sporting calendar, and an outage at a payment, KYC or geolocation supplier does not reach customers.</li> <li>Treat regulation as an engineering requirement, building in auditability, evidence, data boundaries and jurisdictional variation from the start, and hold responsible gaming and player integrity systems to the same standard as any revenue-generating feature.</li> <li>Raise the operational bar across your area. Get hands-on with the most complex incidents, find the root cause, make sure corrective actions remove the class of failure rather than the instance, and support our software as part of an on-call rotation.</li> <li>Simplify the estate. Retire duplicated capability and unnecessary coupling, make considered build-versus-buy choices, and recognise waste in tooling, infrastructure, vendor services and payment processing costs.</li> <li>Set the standard for how AI is used across the software lifecycle in CPE, including where we choose not to use it, with evidence of the effect on throughput, quality and security and the judgement to tell real uplift from theatre.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, Finance and Customer Operations early to shape scope and trade-offs, spot the opportunities CPE’s capabilities open up, and help refocus work that is off course or not making a difference for customers.</li> <li>Coach and mentor engineers, particularly those growing into Staff and Senior Staff roles, spread knowledge through design reviews, talks and written documentation, and take part in hiring senior engineers and managers.</li> <li>Work with Principal Engineers and the wider senior engineering community to shape FanDuel-wide standards for architecture, tooling and engineering practice, and model a culture of quality, candour and collaboration.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>THE STATS</strong></p> <p>What we’re looking for in our next teammate</p> <p>You don’t need all of these to apply, but they all count</p> <ul> <li>Several years as a Staff-level or more senior individual contributor, setting technical direction across multiple teams and bringing them with you through influence rather than authority.</li> <li>A track record of designing and running high-volume transactional systems in payments, financial services, identity or another regulated domain, with a deep grasp of the patterns that keep money and state correct, such as idempotency, reconciliation and event-driven architecture.</li> <li>Extensive experience with highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems under extreme, event-driven peak load, including building on third parties at scale such as payment, KYC and geolocation providers.</li> <li>Experience designing systems where the answer was not yet known, using staged validation to reduce risk, and making pragmatic trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term health.</li> <li>Experience with observability and with using data and KPIs to guide engineering choices and hold systems to a measurable standard of availability and performance.</li> <li>Deep experience in modern back-end languages, functional and object-oriented, including Java, and with cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS), containers and orchestration.</li> <li>Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted software development, with a considered view of where it belongs in the lifecycle, where it does not, and what a regulated environment allows it to touch.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication, from crisp technical narratives that enable decisions to presenting at executive level.</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>THE CONTRACT</strong><br>We treat our team right</p> <p>Competitive compensation is just the beginning. As part of our team, you can expect:</p> <ul> <li>An exciting and fun environment committed to driving real growth</li> <li>Opportunities to build really cool products that fans love</li> <li>Mentorship and professional development resources to help you refine your game</li> <li>Flexible vacation allowance to let you refuel</li> <li>Hall of Fame benefit programs and platforms</li> </ul> <p><em> </em></p> <p><strong>ABOUT FANDUEL GROUP</strong></p> <p>FanDuel Group is a world-class team of brands and products all built with one goal in mind: to give fans new and innovative ways to interact with their favorite games, sports, teams, and leagues. CFGI Directors lead project teams and interact with clients and their Big 4 auditors on all aspects of engagements, including report writing, developing and managing clients relationships, and business development. Take ownership of your career at CFGI: · Gain exposure to a wide range of industries and/or projects. · Make a true business impact with your clients. · Own projects from start to finish. · Experience client interaction and thrive in a client-facing role. · Be consistently challenged and learn through a collegial environment created from top tier experts hired within the firm. · Enjoy the flexibility of office/remote/client site work locations (engagement specific). · Create your own path. · Enjoy what you do! What you might expect : · Interact with clients’ executive team and auditors, serving as a subject matter expert, leading clients through complex accounting issues and driving conclusions. · Lead client engagement and own client delivery on operational due diligence for complex transactions (i.e. – IPO’s, acquisitions and divestitures, stock offerings and debt raises). · Drive client deliverables of financial and regulatory information in accordance with regulatory requirements. · Serve as a subject matter expert on projects related to new accounting standards. · Lead process improvement projects and implementation of changes. · Mentor senior managers, managers, and consultants, acting as a moral and ethical role model, fostering engagement team professional growth, and providing constructive and actionable feedback. · Lead firm initiatives and identify areas for improvements. · Play an active role in the firm’s recruiting efforts, client relationship building, and business development efforts. Who you are: · An undergraduate degree in Accounting – ACA, ACCA, CPA and/or MBA combined with solid accounting experience will be considered in lieu of a degree in accounting. · 12+ years of experience in public accounting and/or industry accounting and/or finance. · Outstanding interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with an ability to assimilate easily into teams. · Strong technical skills and a working knowledge of IFRS, UK GAAP and US GAAP. · Proactive in identifying client needs and effective in building a strong relationship with clients. · Highly organized and focused and demonstrates the ability to set overall engagement expectations and direction. · Effective analytical and critical thinking abilities. · Entrepreneurial nature, self-motivated, ethical, and dependable. · High energy with commitment to quality client service, focusing on ensuring positive resolutions to conflicts. · Consistently seek opportunities to enhance your skills by attending higher-level training, develop firm training materials and enhance overall firm knowledge base. title: Corporate Tax Services - Senior Manager
description: About CFGI: Corporate Finance Group, Inc. (“CFGI”) was founded in 2000 by former Big 4 professionals. CFGI is an established industry leader with the resources to successfully navigate today’s complex accounting, reporting, compliance, and tax landscape. An assemblage of top-flight professionals with in-depth public accounting expertise, CFGI can fulfil a variety of client needs without the restrictions of auditor independence. With a foundation of knowledge amassed while serving a variety of industries, CFGI can guide companies through a wide range of routine and complex business scenarios. The resulting partnership is an innovative resource with the power to address our clients’ most crucial accounting, finance, and operational challenges. We provide our clients with a unique combination of integrity, flexibility, creative solutions, and deep tax technical expertise. Many of our clients are global, market leading, publicly held companies, while others are privately held, early stage, or venture-backed emerging businesses. Here at CFGI, we place a high value on a culture of continued learning, where teamwork is encouraged, and professional excellence is rewarded. Overview of role: CFGI seeks a highly motivated tax manager to join its UK tax team. This role will provide a fantastic opportunity for an individual who is driven, entrepreneurial and constantly looking to challenge the status quo around the UK tax services industry. You will be involved in all aspects of UK corporate tax (reporting, compliance, governance and advisory) and will have direct interaction with both our clients and senior members of the UK tax team in order to deliver these services. 1. Client service delivery a) Tax reporting: You will be involved in the delivery of UK tax reporting services to our diverse client base, which includes the following: · UK publicly listed companies. · US headquartered multinationals (including US listed groups). · UK privately owned and private equity backed groups. The exact scope of tax reporting work for our clients will vary but is likely to include the following: · Preparation of UK entity only tax numbers in accordance with IFRS or UK GAAP. · Preparation of UK group tax numbers, likely to involve the incorporation of tax numbers for non-UK subsidiaries, GAAP-to GAAP adjustments (e.g. US GAAP to IFRS) and consolidation adjustments. · Advising on client’s tax reporting processes. · Advising on the tax aspects of GAAP conversion projects. · Advising on the tax reporting (and other) aspects of IPO readiness. b) UK corporation tax compliance: You will be involved in the preparation and submission of UK corporation tax returns for our clients. This will involve you leading the day-to-day interaction with our clients to obtain all the information required to complete and file their returns in a timely manner. Whilst a formalized compliance process is in place, you will have a good degree of autonomy to manage the process in your own way, albeit with a focus on ensuring that our tax compliance offering is high quality, efficient and cost effective for our clients. c) Tax governance You will be involved in the delivery of our tax governance proposition to clients, advising on tax strategy, risk management and controls. d) Tax advisory You will be involved in tax advisory work likely to include the following: · Ad hoc corporate tax advisory work originating from compliance engagements – e.g. loss planning and utilization, tax implications of trade and asset transfers, interest deductibility. · Cash tax modelling exercises. · Group simplification exercises. · Tax due diligence for client transactions. · Tax structuring for client transactions. 2. Business development As CFGI is looking to rapidly expand in the UK, there will be plenty of opportunity to get involved in business development activities, including the following: · Assisting with the origination of tax opportunities on new and existing clients, drafting of proposals and involvement in the sales process (e.g. meetings, pitches, etc.). · Teaming with colleagues from other CFGI UK and US service areas (e.g. accounting advisory, business transformation) to identify and propose tax opportunities. · Teaming with the CFGI US tax team to support with and identify UK tax opportunities on US clients. · Identifying additional revenue streams with our clients. Skills and Competencies: Knowledge: · Experience of UK tax reporting processes. · Knowledge of tax reporting IFRS and UK GAAP; high level understanding of US GAAP desired but not essential. · Experience of the UK tax return preparation process, and good technical understanding with common tax adjusting items such as capital allowances and other incentives, interest deductibility, hybrid mismatches, loss utilisation etc. · Experience of responding to and managing HMRC tax enquiries. · Knowledge / an appreciation of cross-border tax matters would be highly desirable, e.g. transfer pricing, country by country reporting etc. Skills: · Experienced with using Microsoft Excel and tax software packages i.e. OneSource. · Demonstrated ability to effectively present information and appropriately respond to questions from clients and team members. · Excellent organizational skills, ability to multi-task, and work under deadlines. · Excellent analytical, supervisory, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills are necessary. · Demonstrated ability to be accountable for independently completing assignments. · Capable of collaborating and communicating with people of different technical backgrounds and roles. · Analytical ability to navigate work-related situations with practicality, sound reasoning, and demonstrating creativity in problem solving. · Other key characteristics: the ideal candidate must demonstrate integrity and accountability, always remaining flexible, adaptable, and willing to accept coaching, building and managing professionally healthy relationships, and continually developing awareness of business-related topics. · As an entrepreneurial business you will be working with a growing team and with a range of service lines and so a desire to collaborate and work cross service line will be important. Qualifications: · Three to five years of corporate tax experience with some/all of this time ideally spent in the Big 4. · Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA) required; additional tax qualification (e.g. CTA) strongly desired. title: Senior Account Manager
description: What we do. Electric Car Leasing Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future. We are seeking a Senior Account Manager to join our Customer Success team in London, tasked with driving the commercial success of valuable customer relationships. You will step into a pivotal role, taking full ownership of a high-value enterprise portfolio offering our market-leading EV salary sacrifice scheme. You will be responsible for building multi-year growth plans, managing commercial risks, and securing maximum scheme adoption and long-term retention. This role requires strong gravitas, expert commercial acumen, and an unwavering commitment to translating our mission of sustainable transport into quantifiable success for both our corporate clients and Octopus EV. Please note that you must hold a valid UK driving licence. This role is based in our Oxford Circus office. We’re pretty flexible, to do this role well we think you need to be in for minimum x2 days per week. What you'll do... Drive portfolio growth. Own the account strategy and performance of the largest, most complex and strategically important accounts. Define and execute yearly account plans focused on maximising scheme penetration and expanding the relationship across all areas of the customer’s company. Act a strategic thought leader. Consult with senior stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance, Sustainability) to architect their long term EV benefit or company car strategy. Translate the customer objectives into joint opportunities for scheme success from initial pitch (where you will act as an influencer alongside the BD team), through onboarding and sustained high level adoption. Own the smooth running of the account. While your focus is strategic growth, you will be the ultimate owner of the account. This means personally tackling and resolving client escalations, navigating internal roadblocks, and alongside our Scheme Delivery team ensuring the scheme's day-to-day operations run flawlessly. Help shape the Account Management team. You'll be a key part of how the account management team evolves, bringing your gravitas and positive communication to internal meetings and working groups. This means actively coaching and supporting our rising talent, leading by example with your proactive approach and excellent results, and sharing those 'lightbulb moment' learnings that make us all better. Cultivate Executive Partnership & Influence. Develop and deepen trusted, senior relationships, positioning Octopus EV as an indispensable partner in the customers’ long term business strategy. Ensure Strategic Account Integrity. Take full ownership of long-term account health and retention. Proactively design risk mitigation strategies for regulatory, commercial, or operational challenges, maintaining maximum scheme participation and minimising churn across your entire portfolio. Lead Cross-Functional Alignment. Act as the primary internal voice of the strategic client portfolio. Direct and align internal teams (Product, Operations, Finance) on client requirements and solutions, ensuring the delivery of a seamless, high-quality experience that meets the needs of major corporate customers. Leverage Data for Strategic Influence. Analyse portfolio data and share customer insights to quantify OEV's value to the customer and proactively influence the OEV Product roadmap and operational processes. Build expert-level knowledge. Build a deep understanding of your customer businesses, the industry, market risks and opportunities and link this to strategic plans for your portfolio, and future risks and opportunities for Octopus EV. What you'll need... Deep Commercial Experience (6+ years). Progressive, relevant experience in enterprise account management or another relevant commercial role, ideally within a B2B2C environment or where the revenue model is based on usage of the product Accountability for Strategic Growth. Highly results-accountable, with evidence of exceeding growth and penetration targets and proactive risk mitigation across a high-value portfolio. Advanced Commercial Acumen. Financial literacy and strong commercial acumen used to reach win/win outcomes. Proven ability to lead negotiations with senior finance and procurement stakeholders. Executive-Level Partnership. Demonstrated maturity and gravitas essential for building deep, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Proven ability to influence internal and external strategy and secure buy-in across large, complex organisational structures. Complex Problem Solving. Operate with autonomy, taking full ownership of portfolio performance. Proven ability to design and implement robust solutions for commercial or operational challenges that could impact the entire OEV customer portfolio. Thought Leadership & Senior Communication. A highly articulate and compelling presenter and communicator. Able to confidently present strategic plans and performance reviews to a varied audience. Driving Client Value. Deep passion for client success, with a track record of quantifying and communicating tangible ROI and long-term quantifiable benefits back to clients, ensuring Octopus EV is viewed as an indispensable strategic partner. A Scale-Up Mindset. Demonstrated ability to thrive and lead within a fast-moving, scale-up environment. Able to adjust to change, handle ambiguity, and proactively shape and influence internal process improvements and commercial strategy to support business growth. Industry Knowledge. A genuine passion for sustainability and the EV transition. Knowledge of the EV, employee benefits, and/or automotive leasing markets is a ‘nice to have’. 💚 Why else you'll love it here 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit! 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! 🎁 Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits 🏆 Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024 . We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership Things to note... 🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies 🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt! About us The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK. We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a 'lease for life' through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal. Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience. We're an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcare, Octopus Investments, Octopus Property, Octopus Ventures and Octopus Labs. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic! Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. title: Senior Manager, Legal Engineer
description: With a legacy as a pioneer in the ALSP market, Factor leads the next evolution in legal services through AI-integrated contracting. Factor is the market leader in Integrated Law™, combining the expertise of Traditional Law, the efficiency of New Law, and the close business integration of In-house legal to deliver complex legal work at scale. Factor works alongside corporate legal departments to solve for the ever-increasing demands and complexity of transactional legal work. Our "do while transforming, transform while doing" approach combines specialist expertise, AI-powered solutions, and business process knowledge to deliver better performance, better business and legal outcomes, and a transformed contracting experience. Our clients span Fortune 500 companies including global banks, major pharmaceutical companies and large technology firms. We believe that the more diverse our team becomes — in backgrounds, skills, experiences, and perspectives — the higher our creative potential as a company. We are dedicated to growing a diverse, inclusive company where individuals of all backgrounds thrive. We are comprised of more than 300 lawyers, legal specialists, technologists, and process consultants across Europe and North America – Join us! The role: We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Legal Engineering to play a key role in transforming the delivery of legal services through technology, automation, data, and AI. This is a highly visible, hands-on role for someone who can bridge the gap between legal expertise and technology implementation. You will be responsible for designing and delivering legal engineering solutions that improve efficiency, enhance legal service delivery, and enable the practical adoption of AI across legal operations. Working closely with legal, operations, technology, and client stakeholders, you will lead the development of AI-enabled workflows, legal automation initiatives, reporting frameworks, and process improvements that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires a combination of legal operations expertise, strong technical capability, project leadership, and a passion for innovation Responsibilities Legal Engineering & AI Enablement Design and implement legal technology, automation, and AI-driven solutions. Build AI-ready documentation, including contracts, playbooks, templates, and SOPs. Drive adoption of AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability. Legal Operations & Transformation Lead legal operations and transformation initiatives from design through delivery. Redesign processes to reduce manual effort and improve operational performance. Manage project plans, stakeholders, risks, and delivery milestones. Data, Reporting & Analytics Define and track legal operations and legal delivery KPIs. Develop dashboards and reporting using Power BI, Excel, and SharePoint. Translate operational data into actionable business insights and recommendations. Workflow Automation & Technology Build and optimise workflows using Power Apps, Power Automate, and legal technology platforms. Automate processes including matter intake, contract management, and reporting. Evaluate and implement new technologies that enhance legal service delivery. Stakeholder Leadership Partner with legal, business, and technology teams to deliver solutions. Drive user adoption through training, engagement, and change management. Mentor team members and promote best practices across legal operations. Essential Criteria: Law degree or equivalent legal qualification 8+ years experience working within a legal, legal operations, or legal technology environment. Proven experience designing and implementing AI-enabled legal solutions, automation workflows, and technology-driven process improvements. Hands-on experience building legal automations and deploying technologies such as Power Platform, legal AI tools, document automation, or contract lifecycle management solutions to improve legal service delivery. Experience supporting legal transformation, legal operations, or digital change programmes. Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management, legal data, reporting, and operational metrics. Experience with legal AI, contract review, document automation, or CLM platforms such as ContractPodAi, Ironclad, Agiloft, BRYTER, or Avvoka. Additional Information As a member of an ISO Compliant center, the candidate will be required to follow the policies and procedures on Information Security Management System in place at the Center of Excellence and globally at Factor. As a member of the Factor team, the applicant will have access to various company and client assets and will be required to maintain the level of security as identified for each asset. articulate complex concepts clearly to both technical and operational stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work perks  </span></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our home workplace furniture</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Comprehensive Medical Insurance</li> <li>Group Life and Income Protection title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee. What we are looking for: Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our EMEA team. Fluent German and English language skills are required for this role. What you will be doing: As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximise opportunities for our Enterprise Business customers and Semperis. Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions. You will be responsible for: Design a success plan for a Book of Business of strategic customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upsell, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to reach their business objectives and operational goals You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets Act as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations Monitor record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalised customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc Develop and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.) Identify potential customer references and assist with development of customer case studies Gain and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program What you will bring to the table: Technical & Cyber Security Skills Hands-on product enablement experience with a security product vendor, including running product health checks, articulating the output with expertise, configuring or tuning alert and response rules, remediating Active Directory and Entra security posture vulnerabilities Understanding of security concepts (NIST IR process, MITRE Attack framework, APTs, etc.) and workflows, Active Directory and Entra ID vulnerabilities and attack patterns, IAM and Security team organisation structures Strong foundational knowledge of cyber security domains: Network security, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), identity (IAM/SSO/MFA), SIEM, zero-trust, threat intelligence, etc Fundamental understanding of modern architectures: on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2) Customer-facing & Soft Skills - 5+ years’ experience as a Customer Success Manager, technical account manager, or related customer-facing role in a Cybersecurity SaaS solutions company Executive presence & communication: can explain complex threats or product value to CISOs, CIOs, architects, and analysts in their language Storytelling with data: Turn telemetry, risk scores, and attack surface metrics into compelling business narratives Project/program management: Be in tune with customer onboarding, health checks, maturity roadmaps, and expansion opportunities Conflict resolution & expectation management during incidents or escalations. Consultative selling & value realization: Identify use cases that justify expansion, upsell & cross-sell modules, or multi-year renewals Business & Strategic Skills: Renewal & expansion forecasting (understand ARR, NRR, consumption metrics) Ability to build and Execute Customer Success Plans / Joint Success Plans with Account owners (sales reps) Risk identification (technical debt, low adoption, competing solutions) and mitigation planning (QBRs, escalation paths) Competitive intelligence: Know how your product differentiates from the competition Preferences: Fluent German and English language skills are required Experience with SFDC and Active Directory #LI-LP1 Why Join Semperis? You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you. **Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Where the job description specifies a required location, candidates will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working up to three days per week and remotely the remaining days. description: Why Harvey At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. You will guide firms from first adoption to Harvey being embedded in how their practice groups work, moving each firm along the AI maturity curve by connecting our technology and legal expertise to its own goals, so partners and associates see undeniable value and the firm builds a lasting AI advantage. What You'll Do Deliver the firm's journey : build and run a mutual success plan tied to each firm's objectives, priorities and metrics — practice-group adoption, capacity, client propositions — and deliver kickoffs, implementation reviews, QBRs and executive business reviews to a consistently high standard. Orchestrate cross-functionally : sequence Legal Engineers, Product, Innovation Partners and the Transformation Office intentionally, and bring the voice of the firm back to Product and Engineering. Prove value and expand : align each firm on measurable outcomes — capacity, realisation, matter economics, client impact — capture value stories and ROI evidence, and qualify and progress expansion with your Account Executive. Run your book and own renewal readiness : know whether each firm is in Defend, Maintain or Grow with evidence; prioritise by value, renewal timing and risk; surface risk early and partner with your Account Executive to renew and expand our strategic partnerships. What You Have Ideal candidates for the Enterprise Law Firm CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following: 5+ years in customer-owning roles — Customer Success, account management, legal-tech consulting or an innovation / commercial role inside a law firm — with law-firm customers or stakeholders. An understanding of how law firms work: how partnerships make decisions, how practice groups differ, and what partners, associates and innovation teams each care about. An AI-native way of working: you use AI and sophisticated tooling daily, can show how it has changed your own output, and have a point of view on how AI changes legal practice. title: Senior Privacy Counsel
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we’ve turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In the last couple of years we have gone big and acquired both Carwow Leasey, a leasing broker, and Autovia, creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach of over 350 million. We also launched our successful Sell My Car business in Germany. We are continually driving to make Carwow the go-to destination for people looking to change their car. And we’re a long way from done! LEGAL & COMPLIANCE @ CARWOW Our fantastic legal team has been compared to a set of high-performance tyres, enabling Carwow to drive and corner at high speeds whilst keeping Carwow firmly on the road in all conditions. As the business pushes forward with bold ambitions, the legal team’s purpose is clear: to drive Carwow’s growth with integrity and confidence – and that’s where you come in! YOUR MISSION We are a platform that sits right in the middle between consumers and OEMs/Dealers in the car-changing journey. Datasits at the heart of everything we do and we want to commercialise it responsibly. As Senior Privacy Counsel, you will be Carwow’s dedicated in-house privacy lawyer and operational privacy lead, playing a pivotal role in enabling the business to grow and scale at pace with integrity. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a complex, high-growth and data-thirsty marketplace business. We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel who wants to do more than provide legal advice from the sidelines. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing legal function as our first dedicated in-house privacy hire, taking ownership of the day-to-day privacy programme while acting as a senior legal and strategic advisor to the business as it sharpens its privacy governance programme and steers towards further growth and an exit. We are not at “Day Zero”. We currently have an external DPO, established policies, templates, a RoPA and a risk register. We need a tech-fluent privacy lawyer who is equally comfortable advising and doing: someone who can interpret complex legal requirements, exercise sound legal judgement and provide pragmatic advice, but who will also roll up their sleeves and build, operate and continuously improve the mechanisms that make privacy work in practice. You will have the mandate to lift the lid on our technology stack, validate our data flows, identify legal and operational privacy risks and work directly with our Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and commercial teams to keep the business safe and moving fast. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Privacy governance and framework development: Own, develop and maintain Carwow’s enterprise privacy governance framework, encompassing internal policies, ROPAs, privacy notices, risk registers, retention schedules and associated controls. Interpret applicable legal requirements and ensure our documentation and processes reflect the reality of Carwow’s technology stack and processing activities, leading remediation where discrepancies or risks are identified. Legal advice and business partnering: Act as Carwow’s principal in-house legal advisor on privacy and data protection matters. Develop strong business partnering relationships across Marketing, Media, Product, Engineering, Data and other parts of the business, providing pragmatic, risk-based legal advice that enables commercial objectives while appropriately managing privacy risk. Provide advice to senior management and support the General Counsel in updating the Company’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives as needed. Culture & Training: Build a strong internal perception of privacy as a “trust builder”. Design and deliver role-specific training that is engaging, commercially relevant and free of unnecessary legal jargon, helping teams understand both their legal obligations and how to apply them in practice. Breach response: Lead the privacy aspects of data breach and incident response, working cross-functionally to investigate incidents, assess legal and regulatory risk, determine notification obligations and oversee remediation. Liaise with the external DPO, regulators and other relevant stakeholders as appropriate. DPAs, DSAs and data contracting: Draft, review and negotiate DPAs, DSAs and other data protection provisions and agreements arising from commercial arrangements. Provide practical legal advice on controller/processor relationships, data sharing, international transfers and related privacy risks. DSARs and individual rights: Own and continuously improve Carwow’s processes for responding to data subject rights requests, ensuring requests can be handled lawfully, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the business. Provide legal guidance on complex or sensitive requests where required. Retail Media and Ad Tech: Provide legal and operational privacy support on new commercial propositions looking to leverage Carwow’s data for third-party audience targeting, segmentation and advertising. Advise on the appropriate use of personal data, profiling, consent and data-sharing structures and help design commercially workable and legally robust mechanisms for using and sharing data. Product, Data and Technology: Work closely with Data & Insights, IT, Engineering and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle to embed Privacy by Design. Lead or support privacy assessments, identify legal and operational risks in new products and processing activities, and translate complex technical data flows into clear, risk-based advice for the General Counsel, Executives and wider business. Operationalise Compliance: Own and operate core privacy compliance processes, including DPIAs, LIAs and data-sharing assessments. Look continuously for opportunities to integrate these into existing business workflows, with an eye on making compliance proportionate, scalable and automated wherever possible. Regulatory developments: Monitor and interpret relevant developments in privacy, data protection, digital regulation and related areas, assess their impact on Carwow and translate new legal requirements into practical changes to products, policies, controls and business processes. Corporate work: Provide privacy legal support on M&A, funding and other corporate transactions, including conducting privacy due diligence, identifying material risks and supporting remediation and integration activity. AI and emerging technology: Advise on the privacy implications of AI and emerging technologies adopted or developed across the business, while supporting the development of practical governance mechanisms that allow Carwow to innovate responsibly. Multi-jurisdictional: Support Carwow’s businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal, advising on relevant local and European privacy requirements and working with external counsel where specialist local advice is required. KEY REQUIREMENTS A qualified lawyer, admitted to practise in England & Wales or another relevant UK or European jurisdiction, with significant experience advising on privacy and data protection matters. Significant experience working in-house, balancing legal and regulatory requirements with commercial objectives and operating as a trusted advisor to the business. Strong working knowledge of UK and European data protection law, with the ability to interpret legislation, regulatory guidance and emerging issues and translate them into clear, practical and commercially workable advice. Experience not only providing privacy legal advice but also building, operating or materially contributing to a privacy programme, including areas such as DPIAs, RoPAs, privacy notices, data rights, retention, incident response and privacy governance. The ability and willingness to work autonomously as Carwow’s principal in-house privacy specialist, moving comfortably between complex legal analysis and hands-on operational delivery. Passionate about the intersection of AI and privacy, with an interest in how to safeguard the organisation during technology adoption while also leveraging AI to enhance and automate privacy operations. A team player with a growth mindset, high EQ and low ego, excited to be part of a scale-up, high-growth company where every day brings new challenges and opportunities. To be able to work in a fast-paced environment with teams that move and pivot quickly. Fluency in English and strong written and verbal communication skills, together with a proactive, persuasive and adaptable manner. Driven to ensure the Legal & Compliance Team is viewed as a genuine partner to the business, with the initiative and credibility to build relationships across functions and at senior levels. Ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority. A track record of working effectively with all levels of an organisation, including senior management and executives. BONUS POINTS Experience working in a tech platform or marketplace environment. Experience in Mar-Tech or Ad-Tech. Experience in the automotive industry. Experience advising on AI governance or wider digital regulation. Experience supporting organisations operating across multiple European jurisdictions. A CIPP/E and/or CIPM qualification from the IAPP, or equivalent demonstrable privacy expertise. INTERVIEW PROCESS Introductory call with our Talent team. Interview with our Director of Legal and another member of our Legal Team. Interview with our General Counsel Carwow Values interview with 2 x members of the Carwow business. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working (2 days working from home) Competitive salary Matched pension contributions Share options - when we thrive, so do you! Bupa Private medical and dental insurance, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers Life Assurance Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays 28 days annual leave 1 day for your wedding 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work! For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year The option to work from abroad up to 4 weeks Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h4> <p>The Workflow Platform team builds Addepar's orchestration layer: a platform, on top of Temporal, that lets other Addepar teams turn long-running, multi-step business processes (approvals, data operations, reporting, client notifications) into reliable, observable, human-in-the-loop workflows. title: Senior Network Engineer - Low Latency Trading
description:
<p>The Networks team designs, builds and maintains all the communications infrastructure that allows our high-capacity, low-latency trading and data research environments to run 24/7.  This network spans over 25 countries and 100 locations. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with experience designing and managing large environments to fulfill the high-performance and availability requirements of a premiere algorithmic trading firm operating in global financial markets. </p> <p>This position requires both project management and deep technical skills. Working together with some of the brightest minds in our industry, you’ll be responsible for everything from product selection and design to routing configuration and troubleshooting. You will work closely with our Systems and Trading Operations teams as well as others at HRT to build, manage, and monitor our low-latency trading network. You’ll have broad responsibilities with freedom to analyze and solve problems, and your solutions will have an immediate impact on our worldwide operations. </p> <p>We’re looking for someone with a love for technology and an excitement for tackling big picture problems. You will work on a wide variety of projects to enhance the performance and capacity of the global trading and research platforms and contribute to both high-level strategy and the technical nitty-gritty of our global network architecture.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related IT field</li> <li>5-10 years of relevant experience, preferably in low-latency and high-frequency trading environments.</li> <li>In depth understanding of common layer 2 and layer 3 network protocols and best practices; working knowledge of OSPF, BGP, PIM, IGMP</li> <li>Experience managing Arista, Cisco, and other common networking devices on a day-to-day basis</li> <li>Familiarity with low-latency microwave networks and/or optical transmission systems, such as Adva, Ciena is desirable</li> <li>Experience in designing enterprise networks, capacity planning, and full lifecycle project management</li> <li>Experience with packet decoding and analysis tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark</li> <li>Excellent oral and written communication skills: able to distill complicated issues into clear and concise terms and to create and maintain effective technical documentation</li> <li>Experience with Unix/Linux command line utilities and networking stack</li> <li>Excellent troubleshooting skills on a wide range of networking issues, including common ethernet LAN problems, multicast market data distribution, and global WAN</li> <li>Understanding of basic power consumption and cooling issues in a datacenter environment</li> <li>Knowledge of fiber optics technology and cabling standards. Ability to sort through specs and make recommendations on appropriate purchases</li> <li>Willingness and ability to solve small technical problems in the field yourself.</li> <li>You have excellent collaboration skills and a willingness to admit mistakes.</li> <li>Familiarity with firewalls (including Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet), VPNs and NAT</li> <li>Familiarity with configuration management tools, such as Ansible or Salt is desirable</li> <li>Familiarity with Python, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, GitHub is desirable</li> <li>Familiarity with public cloud networks, such as AWS, GCP, Azure, is desirable</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. title: AI Research Engineer
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.</p> <p>As a research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda.</p> <p>We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong engineering skills, especially any of: CUDA/Triton/Pallas/CuTe DSL kernel development, lower-level PyTorch/JAX/XLA development, CUDA Graphs, FPGA/ASIC experience</li> <li>Must have two or more years work experience building deep learning systems, for any domain: language, speech, robotics, biology, chemistry, physics, audio, video, recommendations, etc.</li> <li>Experience translating methods between areas of application is highly valued</li> <li>Must be comfortable writing PyTorch or JAX code</li> <li>Deep learning research experience is valuable, but not necessary</li> <li>LLM experience is valuable, but not necessary</li> <li>Finance experience is not required</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 250,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Culture</strong></p> <p><span data-sheets-value="{"1":2,"2":"Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: left;"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 100%;" src="https://brand.auctane.com/uploads/fhmikF1ylz02TLjtkC429w.png" alt="" width="600"></h2> <p> </p> <p style="color: #11003a; font-weight: bold; padding: 8px; border: 3px solid #5C50FF; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 8px;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About us</span></p> <p>At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.</p> <p>The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.</p> <p style="color: #11003a; font-weight: bold; padding: 8px; border: 3px solid #5C50FF; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 8px;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our values</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><img style="max-width: 100%;" src="https://postimg.cc/N5Q8NR10" alt=""><span data-teams="true">Make it Right. You will balance the needs of our existing enterprise customers with the development of scalable capabilities across the wider ShipStation Global portfolio. Reporting to the European Product Leader, this is a product leadership role for someone with proven experience building and managing enterprise SaaS products. You will combine deep customer understanding with strong commercial judgement and the ability to navigate complex software environments, shape platform strategy and lead product teams to deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.<br><br><strong>This role is a hybrid remote opportunity based in London.</strong></p> <p style="color: #11003a; font-weight: bold; padding: 8px; border: 3px solid #5C50FF; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 8px;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What will you be doing?</span></p> <ul> <li>Own the Metapack product roadmap, prioritisation and investment decisions, balancing customer needs, commercial returns and long-term platform strategy</li> <li>Lead, develop and grow the Product Management team, working closely with Engineering, Architecture, Design, Data, Operations and Commercial leaders</li> <li>Drive the development of shared product capabilities, including tracking and analytics, that can be leveraged across the wider ShipStation Global portfolio</li> <li>Work closely with the API Product Director to align customer requirements and integration priorities across APIs, carrier systems, WMS, OMS, ERP and ecommerce platforms</li> <li>Understand the operational complexity of large enterprise customers, translating their business needs, workflows and requirements into scalable product capabilities</li> <li>Lead platform simplification, consolidation and migration initiatives, balancing customer commitments with long-term technical and product sustainability </li> <li>Own product performance and commercial outcomes, using metrics such as ARR, retention, expansion, contribution, adoption and cost to serve to guide investment decisions</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Solutions, Customer Success and Account Management on strategic opportunities, RFPs, solution design, renewals and customer escalations</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders, representing Product in strategic reviews, QBRs and industry events, and making clear trade-offs between customer needs, strategic priorities and technical debt</li> </ul> <p style="color: #11003a; font-weight: bold; padding: 8px; border: 3px solid #5C50FF; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 8px;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What are we looking for?</span></p> <ul> <li>Proven product leadership in enterprise B2B SaaS, with substantial direct ownership of customer-facing enterprise products or platforms — this is mandatory</li> <li>Typically 7+ years in product management, including significant experience leading product strategy, teams and commercial outcomes at Director, Head of Product or equivalent level</li> <li>Deep practical understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, including complex implementation, integration, configuration, data, security, governance and support needs</li> <li>Experience designing for complex, high-volume operations, multiple user personas, roles and permissions, and customers operating across sites, regions or business units</li> <li>Proven experience managing international enterprise customer relationships and leading globally distributed Product and Engineering teams based in London and Poland, with the ability to collaborate effectively across regions, cultures, and time zones (including US Central Time)</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise procurement, RFPs, security and technical due diligence, contractual commitments, long sales cycles, and renewals</li> <li>Ability to engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders and executives while working effectively with architects and engineers on complex technical trade-offs</li> <li>Great communication and presentation skills, with comfort presenting and public speaking to senior customer stakeholders, internal executive audiences, and events.</li> <li>Professional English proficiency (not necessarily native)</li> <li>Strong alignment with company values (‘Play to Win’, ‘Make it Right’, ‘Win as One’) — collaborative, action-oriented, pragmatic, highly accountable, adaptable, and enthusiastic.</li> </ul> <p style="color: #11003a; font-weight: bold; padding: 8px; border: 3px solid #5C50FF; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 8px;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What will make you stand out?</span></p> <ul> <li>Logistics, shipping, carrier management, fulfilment, retail operations or supply-chain software</li> <li>Platform consolidation, legacy modernisation, product migration or post-merger portfolio integration</li> <li>Partnerships, white-label propositions, enterprise integration ecosystems or build-versus-partner decisions</li> <li>Data products, analytics and responsible application of AI to complex enterprise workflows</li> </ul> <p style="color: #11003a; offer?</span></p> <ul> <li>💸 Clear and transparent compensation plan. The salary range for this role is £ 115,807 - £ 150,550 depending on experience. We will discuss the indicated range with you in the first recruiting call to ensure that we are on the same page. </li> <li>🗓️ Annual Salary Review: We are reviewing the salaries of all our teams annually in order to evaluate an increase according to individual performance and the business results.</li> <li>📦 99% discount on your personal shipment orders via Packlink.pro</li> <li>💙 Up to 150 USD/year to match your NGO donations! Leave your suit behind... we’re a t-shirt and converse kind of place! More importantly, our company culture promotes diversity and inclusion. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid, and we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.</li> <li>🌍 A cross-cultural atmosphere. We want to help you improve your technical skills, feel involved in the product community, and develop your soft skills to lead teams and manage other stakeholders.</li> <li>💰 Pension Scheme.
