Auctane contributes up to 4% to the employee’s pension, providing the employee matches the contribution.</li> <li>🛡️ We got you covered. You can take advantage of our Group Life Assurance and our Group Income Protection.</li> <li>🤰🏽 Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave. Auctane enhances both maternity and paternity pay. Three months of maternity leave or two weeks of paternity leave

title: Software Implementation Project Manager
description: About 3E: 3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges. Join us and make an impact! About the Role As an Implementation Project Manager at 3E, you’ll lead larger, more complex customer implementations where successful delivery requires multiple products, technical contributors, workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders to operate against one coordinated plan. You’ll be accountable for turning the customer’s scope of work into an executable implementation strategy and for determining whether the overall project succeeds—on time, within scope, adopted, and connected to a clear customer outcome. You’ll establish success and acceptance criteria, own the integrated project plan, manage risk and change, coordinate specialists and technical teams, and give both customers and 3E leadership a clear, data-backed view of project health. You’ll understand the technical delivery deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify dependencies, connect customer needs with the right specialists, and engage credibly with Product and Engineering. You won’t need to personally execute every configuration, migration, or integration; your role is to ensure those pieces come together into a successful customer outcome. What You’ll Do Lead complex new-logo, cross-sell, and Value Realization implementations from internal handoff through customer acceptance and formal close. Translate complex scopes of work into an integrated delivery strategy covering products, workstreams, milestones, resources, dependencies, assumptions, exclusions, and acceptance criteria. Lead technical discovery and pre-integration planning with customers, CX technical specialists, and relevant internal teams. Own the master implementation plan and coordinate implementation specialists, Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, technical consultants, external partners, and customer resources. Establish measurable success and acceptance criteria at kickoff and maintain accountability for those outcomes throughout delivery. Lead customer project governance, including senior stakeholder and sponsor communications. Maintain the milestone tracker and conduct phase-gate reviews, giving a clear assessment of whether projects are on track, at risk, or behind and establishing mitigation plans when required. Identify cross-workstream dependencies and risks early and determine their impact on the critical path. Lead complex, multi-product delivery by managing scope and change control, coordinating custom development through launch, maintaining a unified customer plan across teams, and providing leadership with clear, data-backed reporting on project health, risk, timelines, value, and adoption. Build and maintain dashboards or reporting tools that make project status and risks visible without relying solely on status meetings. Lead customer escalations diplomatically while maintaining accountability for customer commitments, decisions, resources, data readiness, and signoffs. Partner with Commercial on implementation handoff and identify expansion opportunities or renewal risks surfaced during delivery. Represent the delivery perspective during pre-sales scoping of complex or higher-risk opportunities so commitments can be successfully delivered. Drive structured post-onboarding Value Realization Projects, including complex migrations, integrations, optimization, remediation, and workflow initiatives. Manage multiple concurrent implementations and make prioritization decisions based on risk, complexity, dependencies, and customer impact. Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, delivery predictability, time-to-value, and the overall customer experience. What Makes You a Great Fit Required 3–5 years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, technical account or project management, or professional services, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or information services. Experience with SAP EHS implementation is required. Demonstrated experience leading complex customer implementations with multiple workstreams, technical dependencies, contributors, or products. Experience owning project scope, plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, change control, customer communication, and delivery outcomes. Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand configuration, data, integration, and technical delivery sufficiently to coordinate specialists and identify risk; coding is not required. Demonstrated ability to lead customer conversations and communicate credibly with senior customer stakeholders. Ability to lead and influence cross-functional contributors without formal authority. Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and making informed prioritization decisions based on customer and business impact. Ability to navigate ambiguity and changing scope while maintaining accountability for outcomes. Willingness to travel 10–20%. Preferred Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, environmental science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Experience with enterprise and/or mid-market SaaS customers. Experience developing or improving implementation processes and customer journeys. Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or enablement tools such as Pendo, Gong, or Zendesk. Experience working with time-to-value, adoption, usage, or customer health metrics. Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical management, SDS, EHS, or sustainability software. Multilingual capability and/or experience supporting global customers. Disclosures: 3E is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on any legally protected categories. For applicants who would like to request accommodation, please contact us Candidate Privacy Notice Agencies : 3E is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at 3E via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of 3E. No fee will be paid if 3E hires the candidate because of the referral or through other means. Visit our Website or follow us on LinkedIn Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Programme Manager
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Every payment we process runs on the infrastructure we built. At Checkout.com , the Cloud Platform team owns the cloud foundations that global payments depend on: a large multi-account AWS estate, a growing Azure platform, and the networking and connectivity that reaches card schemes and banks worldwide. We are building a platform that lets product teams run across multiple clouds and regions. We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager who can turn a complex, multi-team technical programme into a plan people trust and deliver against. This is a senior role in an established, fast-moving team. You will own the multi-cloud and multi-region programme end to end: the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the roadmap. You will bring enough technical depth to work as a peer with our engineers and architects, and pair it with a product mindset: you treat the platform as a product with internal customers, and you judge success by whether those teams adopt it. As a Senior Technical Programme Manager, you are responsible for delivering the programme across teams you don't manage. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure the programme meets the standards a regulated payments business demands. What we are looking for: A track record of delivering large infrastructure or platform programmes: a cloud migration, a new region, a cloud landing zone build, a data centre exit, or similar infrastructure related project within a fast paced technology environment Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers. You won’t need low level knowledge but you should be comfortable discussing networking between clouds and regions, identity and access, infrastructure as code pipelines, and what latency, data residency and failover mean for payments workloads Experience working with cloud providers and partners to align their support and funding with your delivery plan, ideally Azure alongside AWS Product thinking applied to internal platforms: you have treated engineering teams as customers, worked out what they need, and measured whether they adopted it. Clear written and verbal communication with senior stakeholders Proven ability to get commitments from teams and leaders who don't report to you. Experience in a regulated environment, such as financial services or payments How you’ll make an impact: Run the programme end to end, from sequencing the work through to production, across several teams and multiple cloud providers. Own the roadmap. Understand what product engineering teams need before they can deploy into Azure or a new cloud region, help decide which paved roads come first, and set adoption measures we can report on. Turn architecture decisions into delivery plans. Work with our senior engineers and architects on design trade-offs, make sure decisions get written down, and spot when a decision is blocking delivery. Manage dependencies and risk across teams you don't control, and escalate early, with options, when something is going to slip. Build compliance from the start. PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2 apply to most of what this programme touches, and control requirements need to show up in the plan, before any production workloads go live. Keep the delivery records honest. Our roadmap lives in Jira Product Discovery and delivery in Jira; you'll work with the relevant teams to make sure both reflect what is actually happening. Use AI tools in how you run the programme: status reporting, dependency analysis, drafting and keeping documentation current. We use them heavily and expect you to as well. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? title: Marketing Generalist
description: Company Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI. We develop ultra-low-latency neural text-to-speech systems that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure. By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we are making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure. Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and is backed by leading B2B venture capital firms in Europe. Our customers include OEM handset manufacturers, chip manufacturers, and consumer AI companies building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone. We’re solving challenging problems across real-time machine learning, edge inference, streaming systems, and ultra-low-latency infrastructure. If you enjoy working in a fast-moving environment and turning technical ideas into something people want to talk about, you’ll feel at home here. Role We’re looking for a Marketing Generalist to help build Neuphonic’s brand and grow awareness of our technology. This is a hands-on role for someone who is excited about AI, startups and technology, and wants to work across a broad range of marketing activities. You’ll work closely with the founders and wider team to help turn what we are building into interesting content, campaigns and moments that get people talking about Neuphonic. We’re looking for someone who is proactive, creative and highly organised. You don’t need to come in with a fully formed marketing playbook. What matters more is that you are curious, move quickly and are happy to take an idea and make it happen. Your work will include: Creating and publishing content across LinkedIn, X, our website and other relevant channels Helping plan and execute product launches, open-source releases and company announcements Turning technical work from our engineering and research teams into clear, engaging content Coming up with creative ideas to increase awareness of Neuphonic and our products Helping organise events, demos, conferences and other marketing activities Supporting campaigns and identifying interesting companies, communities and audiences to reach Writing case studies, blog posts, newsletters and other marketing materials Tracking the performance of campaigns and content and learning what works Keeping our website, social channels and marketing materials up to date Jumping into ad hoc projects and helping wherever needed as the company grows This is a broad role with lots of ownership. Some weeks you might be helping launch a new model, others you might be creating content from a research paper, organising an event or testing a new campaign. You have Around 2–5 years of experience in marketing, content, growth, communications or a similar role Ideally, experience working at a startup and helping it grow or scale Excellent written communication skills and the ability to explain ideas clearly and simply A genuine interest in AI, technology and startups Strong organisational skills and attention to detail The ability to take ownership of a task and drive it through to completion A creative mindset and lots of ideas for how to make technical products interesting A willingness to learn quickly and get involved in lots of different areas Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change In addition, one or more of the following would be particularly valuable: Experience as an early marketing hire or working in a small, fast-growing team Experience creating content for a technology or startup audience Familiarity with LinkedIn, X, newsletters or other content channels Experience with tools such as Figma, Canva, Webflow, Framer or similar An interest in developer marketing, open source or technical communities Experience helping with events, product launches or campaigns Basic understanding of analytics and measuring marketing performance Most importantly, we’re looking for a do-er. Someone who doesn’t need a perfectly defined brief before getting started, is happy to try things, and takes pride in getting good work out into the world. Location: London (King’s Cross) - in-office role. Benefits Help us set the company culture - you’d be joining us as part of our founding team. Help us set and guide the company culture! Whether it’s breakfasts, reading groups or games nights. Give us your ideas and we’ll make it happen together. Competitive salary and equity - we want to make sure you’re rewarded not just in financial terms but also have a sizeable stake in the business as well. We’re in this together. Private health insurance - your health and well-being is paramount. We want to make sure that everyone in the company is supported when it comes to health. Conference, travel and development budget - your development will also grow the business. We want to make sure that you have access to the resources and opportunities you need to be at your best. title: Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA
description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. We are seeking an experienced Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one. Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role. What you’ll do as a Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA at Vanta: Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region How to be successful in this role: Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company. Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. This role requires an in-office hybrid schedule, with 3 days per week in the London office. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office Pension matching 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time 8 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. description: <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We are hiring a <strong>Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager</strong> to lead the team that keeps Canonical's security and compliance credible to the Enterprises, Clouds, Telcos and Governments that run on Ubuntu, and to bring our controls and risk management to the standard a public company requires.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Location</strong>: EMEA or Americas — fully remote (home-based), with the option to work from our London office.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>About our Team</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Canonical's customers trust Ubuntu with critical systems. The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team produces that evidence and makes it real across the company. As Canonical prepares to list on a public exchange, the team is also central to the controls and risk reporting our Audit Committee and Board rely on.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The team is part of Operations and reports to the Chief Operating Officer. It covers both sides of the discipline: keeping us certified and compliant today, and looking ahead at risk across corporate IT, infrastructure and products. It works closely with Engineering, Security Operations, Information Systems, Legal, Finance and Sales.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">You will lead the team, set its priorities and operating rhythm, and be the first escalation point for security and compliance decisions.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Lead and develop a team of GRC engineers: hire, coach and set priorities, and run a roadmap that balances planned work with operational requests, so the team delivers predictably and reports progress clearly to leadership. You own the team’s budget, vendors and tooling.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Own our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications end to end: audit readiness, evidence management framework across corporate IT, infrastructure and products — asset classification, risk assessments, the risk register and key risk indicators — so leadership and the Board can see and 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Build business continuity and disaster recovery with Information Systems and business owners — impact analysis, plans and tested recovery — so critical services university</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience preparing a company for a public listing</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>Role: Senior Marketplace Manager  - THG Nutrition </strong></p> <p><strong>Report to - Head of Marketplaces</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF </strong></p> <p><strong>THG Nutrition & Wellness</strong>: </p> <p><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak">THG Nutrition & Wellness is home to some of the best loved and most trusted names in wellbeing and nutrition, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, its family of brands, Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.</span></p> <p>We want to be the world's most empowering health movement, championing everyone to live healthier, more active lives. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries, to power and empower those who want more. We break conventions, we’re a force for good, and we keep it real. These are the values that drive us through every day. </p> <p>Everything we do is done in-house, from manufacturing and new product development to content creation, e-commerce, marketing and logistics. This means we’re perfectly positioned to deliver to our vision and keep our place at the top of a fast-moving, global industry.  </p> <p>It's an incredibly exciting time to join the team, and we’re always looking for talented people who share our vision and values to drive our Nutrition & Wellness movement forward. </p> <p><strong>About the role: </strong></p> <p> </p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are seeking a commercially-minded, data-driven </span><span data-contrast="auto">Marketplace Manager</span><span data-contrast="auto"> to join our team and lead the execution and tracking of our budget across Amazon and other marketplaces. title: Data Architect
description: <h2>Opportunity</h2> <p>Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for a Data Architect to join our AI Lab and shape the technical and data foundations that enable us to build and scale proprietary AI products securely and effectively.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, influential role spanning architecture and practical delivery. You will take a portfolio-wide view of how data, applications, models, APIs and shared components fit together, creating reusable patterns and capabilities that help engineers move faster while maintaining high standards of security, resilience and maintainability.</p> <p>Working closely with AI Engineers, Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams, you will ensure the Lab has the architecture and underlying platform it needs to innovate at pace while aligning with Brunswick’s wider technology environment.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Design and evolve the data and technical architecture underpinning the AI Lab’s portfolio of proprietary products.</li> <li>Define scalable patterns for how applications, data sources, models, APIs and enterprise systems connect and interact.</li> <li>Design approaches to data modelling, access, storage, movement and governance, particularly for sensitive or business-critical information.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.</li> <li>Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.</li> <li>Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.</li> <li>Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.</li> <li>Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:</p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.</li> <li>Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.</li> <li>Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering approaches, including Python.</li> <li>Experience designing reusable technical components, shared services or platforms used across multiple products or teams.</li> <li>A strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy, lineage and quality, and how these are embedded into architecture and delivery.</li> <li>An understanding of the data requirements of AI and machine-learning applications, including securely making structured and unstructured enterprise data available to AI solutions.</li> <li>A good understanding of modern software engineering and SDLC practices, including CI/CD, version control, testing and observability.</li> <li>Sufficient hands-on technical depth to work credibly with engineers, review designs and contribute to implementation where useful.</li> <li>Strong judgement and pragmatism, with the ability to balance consistency and reuse with experimentation and speed.</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical colleagues.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable experience</p> <ul> <li>Architecting applications or platforms incorporating generative AI, large language models or machine learning.</li> <li>Designing data and integration architectures for AI applications, including retrieval and grounding approaches.</li> <li>Building internal developer platforms, shared services or reusable application frameworks.</li> <li>Working with sensitive enterprise data and complex security or governance requirements.</li> <li>Experience in professional services, financial services, advisory or another complex enterprise environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <p>Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About Brunswick</h1> <p>Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. </p> <p>Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.</p> <p>Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. </p> <p> </p> <p><em>Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our <a href="https://www.brunswickgroup.com/app/uploads/Group-Privacy-Notice-for-Employees_April-2026.pdf" target="_blank">Global Privacy Notice</a> to understand how your data is managed.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution. Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals. Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics. Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance. What You'll Need to Thrive Essential Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation. Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions. Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority. Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy. Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact. Nice to Have Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments. Background working across international or multi-market structures. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness . title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling. As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities. This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow "AI seller" title. Role and Responsibilities Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition. Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity. Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer. Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders. Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases. Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome. Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close. Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload. Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance. Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses. Travel within the assigned territory as required. Required Skills and Experience 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus. Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline. Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners. Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases. Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software. Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills. Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences. Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills. B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field. Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred. title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: About Us Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe. We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts. Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability. The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Integrate against REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, shaping the contracts with backend engineers rather than accepting whatever is offered. Clear communication, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and trade-offs in plain English. description: Finance Deserves Better Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a long, complex deal. An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why. This individual would have responsibility over the full partner lifecycle from onboarding, launch and ongoing maintenance.</p> <p>The TAM role will work closely with the rest of the DataOne business which includes Product, Engineers, Analytics and Commercial counterparts in order to deliver the best experience to our partners.</p> <p>The TAM’s main focusses will be setting up new Partners to start using DataOne open banking data, being on hand to assist partners with changes, and help drive the performance of their open banking usage.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you will be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>Relationship Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>The main point of contact for our partner relationships after contracts are signed; working closely with our Commercial team to understand needs and goals of Partners.</li> <li>Understand the Partners business objective and be able to be proactive in our approach to establish and maintain excellent partner relationships.</li> <li>Attend and support our Commercial team in partner calls</li> <li>Assist in researching trends and insights around delivering best in class partner relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Integration SME</strong></p> <ul> <li>Onboard partners through the integration process, you will be the SME for each individual integration that they own and represent the voice of partners.</li> <li>Ensure that partners stay within the defined strategy of the DataOne team. When a partner is identified for bespoke integration, work with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, and other identified teams to work through solutions for implementing the bespoke work.</li> <li>Take a data-driven approach to provide key partner insights about the integrations, and use these insights to improve our integration experience.</li> <li>Coordinate and manage Partner onboarding plans with our Commercial and Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage all partner requests related to their usage of DataOne’s open banking services. Not only will you manage and process these changes, but you’ll also recommend improvements to ensure high Partner performance.</li> <li>Develop a working knowledge of the ClearScore marketplace landscape and share that knowledge with the wider DataOne team</li> <li>Create custom reports for Partners as and when requested.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Delivery Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Liaise with DataOne engineers to manage backlog of requests.</li> <li>Develop and document processes and procedures to drive efficiencies</li> <li>Collaborate with the DataOne teams to improve functionality to drive down BAU work and drive productivity of our Engineering teams.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a background in Technical Product Ownership, Engineering, or another technical role with direct relationships with clients or partners.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills we'd love you to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A natural planner - ability to coordinate and lead internal and external teams to deliver strong integration performance</li> <li>Highly analytical and data driven - excited by and proficient at using data to make informed decisons</li> <li>Confident working alongside and influencing senior stakeholders</li> <li>Strong writing, communication and presentation skills</li> <li>Organised, proactive, and great attention to detail</li> <li>Positive attitude, able to work under pressure and within a moving framework</li> </ul> <p></p> <p> </p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Why ClearScore?</strong></p> <p>ClearScore is the UK's #1 credit score and report app. We are also present in South Africa, Australia and Canada, with more than 20 million users globally and growing fast. Someone joins ClearScore every 20 seconds.</p> <p>We have established relationships with over 50 of the main lenders in the U.K., and have been a trusted tool for customers to manage their credit and make better financial decisions.</p> <p>Since October 2016 we have helped 1.8 million users take out a new credit card or loan. We are user-centric at our core and we believe in leveraging technology to enable positive financial choices. We are design-led and data-driven and we embed these behaviours in everything we do.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">What is D·One?</strong></p> <p>D·One was created in 2022 as a result of ClearScore’s acquisition of Money Dashboard - a company with best in class open banking and categorisation capabilities. The D·One mission exists to provide open banking data to lending partners, market researchers including hedge funds and ClearScore. Currently, our primary goal is enabling lenders to adopt open banking by delivering a lender specific open banking service with best-in-class credit analytics.</p> <p>As part of the ClearScore Group, you will join a company where our culture is a fundamental part of all we have achieved. We believe in hiring smart, driven, passionate and diverse people who are keen on having a real impact in our organisation. We trust you to manage your own time so we offer flexible work and no fixed desk hours. We don't micromanage and we believe in measuring outcomes rather than effort. We have an inclusive culture where all, regardless of seniority, are encouraged to contribute with their ideas, look after their wellbeing and actively seek opportunities for career growth.</p> <p>If you feel like this could be the place for you, apply and our Talent team will be happy to share more.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 paid holidays and a “duvet day” on your birthday</li> <li>Hybrid Work Environment</li> <li>Private health and dental cover - including mental health support through Bupa </li> <li>GP office visits</li> <li>Life assurance scheme</li> <li>Up to 6% matched pension</li> <li>Regular Lunch and Learns with guest speakers</li> <li>Dog-friendly office</li> <li>Daily breakfast and free snacks</li> <li>Access to discounts via Cobens Extras </li> <li>Free sports and social clubs</li> <li>Continued investment into learning and development </li> <li>Leadership-led training</li> <li>In-house psychotherapist</li> <li>Financial coach to help you plan and achieve your goals</li> <li>No clock-watching culture</li> <li>Generous maternity and paternity plans</li> <li>Culture and inclusion representatives</li> <li>Transparent pay structure and a career growth plan</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong></p> <p>ClearScore is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. As an equal opportunity employer, we are able to make reasonable adjustments to accommodate individuals with disabilities during the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please inform us in advance, and we will work with you to meet your needs.</p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Our Hybrid Model</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We embrace a dynamic hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with collaborative in-person experiences. Our approach is designed to foster innovation, team connection, and individual productivity.</div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Levels 1-5: Minimum 2 days per week in-office</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Level 6 and above: Minimum 3 days per week in-office</li> </ul> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We believe this structure offers the best of both worlds - the flexibility of remote work and the synergy of face-to-face collaboration. Our office days are carefully coordinated to maximise team interactions and learning/ mentorship opportunities.</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><br><strong>What This Means for You:</strong></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Flexibility to manage your work and life</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Dedicated in-office days for team building and collaborative projects</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"> Office facilities (with plants!) designed for productive interactions</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Clear expectations and support for maintaining our hybrid schedule</li> </ul> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment that accommodates diverse needs while maintaining our collaborative culture. Join us in shaping the future of work!</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">Note: While we offer flexibility, commitment to our hybrid schedule is an important aspect of our team culture and performance expectations.</em></div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong data-redactor-tag="strong">Inclusion Policy</strong></p> <p>We are always looking for talented individuals to join ClearScore. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our people. Please see our People Policy Notice at <a href="https://www.clearscore.com/people-notice">https://www.clearscore.com/people-notice</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph" data-ccp-parastyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"aaed607e-c2a3-5841-9fb4-41037bfa0faf|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"3",201342449,"1",469777841,"Times New Roman",469777842,"Times New Roman",469777843,"Times New Roman",469777844,"Times New Roman",201341986,"1",469769226,"Times New Roman",268442635,"24",469775450,"paragraph",201340122,"2",134233614,"true",469778129,"paragraph",335572020,"1",134233118,"true",134233117,"true",469778324,"Normal"]}">Reporting to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SpellingErrorV2Themed SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">Metrea’s</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> Procurement Manager, th</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">is role</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> will</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> primarily</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> execute and manage end-to-end procurement activities across the UK and EU operations. title: Senior Software Engineer - Foundations
description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role LemFi's Foundations tribe is the platform backbone every product team relies on. We own onboarding and identity (KYC end-to-end), engagement systems (rewards, CRM tooling, Lemfi cash), and the internal SDKs and architectural standards that let other squads move fast without reinventing the wheel. If it touches how a customer gets onto the platform or how teams build reliably on top of it, it runs through us. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is at home in Go, cares deeply about building things that last, and has the ownership instinct to drive a system from design to production with minimal hand-holding. You will be a key technical voice in the tribe - setting standards, shipping real product, and enabling the rest of engineering to move faster because of the work you do. What you'll build and own Own and evolve our core identity and onboarding services - KYC flows, verification orchestration and the data contracts that downstream systems depend on. Build and maintain internal SDKs and shared libraries that abstract platform concerns (auth, identity, caching, eventing) so product teams can move without friction. Define and champion cross-platform architectural standards, making opinionated decisions about service design, API contracts and data consistency that the wider engineering org follows. Drive engagement platform capabilities - rewards logic, CRM integrations and Lemfi cash - from spec to production, using AI-assisted development tooling to compress iteration cycles without sacrificing correctness. Partner closely with platform and infrastructure teams to raise the reliability and observability bar across Foundations-owned services. Tackle the hard, ambiguous problems - new country launches, regulatory identity requirements, scaling events - and turn them into clean, well-documented solutions. Contribute to a high-ownership engineering culture: code reviews, architectural reviews, incident response and mentoring are part of the job, not extras. Your experience At least five years of backend engineering experience with Go as your primary language in a production environment. A track record of building and scaling distributed systems - you have seen things break at scale and know how to design so they do not. Experience working on or closely with platform or enablement teams: shared libraries, internal tooling, developer experience or API gateways. Comfortable with the full lifecycle - design, build, operate, improve - with evidence of genuine end-to-end ownership rather than handing off to other teams. Practical, demonstrable use of AI development tools in your daily engineering workflow; you validate AI output rather than blindly accepting it. Strong opinions about system design, API contracts and service boundaries, backed by real examples you can walk us through. Nice to have Exposure to fintech, payments or identity/KYC systems. Experience building SDKs or developer-facing platform services consumed by other engineering teams. Prior work in a high-growth startup or scale-up (roughly 50-500 people) where you had to set standards, not just follow them. Why join LemFi? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play . Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities. Recruitment agencies notice LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee. AI in hiring at LemFi We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description: About Artificial Help shape the future of specialty insurance At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. In February, we raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the role We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to make our applications, and the platform they run on, secure. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work inside our engineering teams, review how our platforms are designed, find where they are weak, and help get them fixed. Much of the job is setting up practices we don't yet have. You'll make threat modelling a normal part of how we plan and build, introduce vulnerability management across our applications and AWS infrastructure, and automate security testing at every stage of the delivery pipeline. We want checks that run on every change, so engineers find problems early and fix them in their own teams without everything having to route through you. We're investing in AI-assisted engineering across the company, and we have a working group exploring where it helps us build better software. Security is part of that work from the start. You'll join the working group, set the guardrails and automated checks that hold every change to the same standard however it was written, and use the same tools in your own work. Job responsibilities Make threat modelling a standard part of how engineering plans and builds, run it on the highest-risk work, and train teams to do their own Review the security architecture of our platforms end to end, and turn what you find into prioritised work Set up and run vulnerability management across application code and AWS infrastructure, with a clear severity model and agreed fix times Build automated security testing into every stage of the pipeline, covering secrets scanning, static and dynamic testing and dependency checks, tuned so it catches real problems without getting in the way Run internal penetration testing as a continuing activity, using AI tools to test features as they ship, and coordinate external testing Put AWS security guardrails in place as Terraform, and keep configuration from drifting Set up how we manage and rotate secrets, and build controls for our software supply chain Test that customer data stays properly separated between tenants, and keep production data out of non-production Build the guardrails for agentic engineering, covering what agents can access, how they are sandboxed, which tools and connectors they can use, and the checks agent-written code has to pass before it merges Give engineers practical security advice day to day, and fix issues yourself when that is the fastest way to get them fixed About you Skills, experience and qualifications Strong product or application security background built on software engineering experience, and comfortable reading, writing and reviewing code Experience running threat modelling and getting engineering teams to adopt it as their own Experience introducing vulnerability management that engineering teams work to Hands-on with security testing across the pipeline, including secrets scanning, SAST, DAST and SCA, and with tuning those tools to cut noise Experience penetration testing web applications and APIs Good working knowledge of AWS security, including access and identity, networking and encryption, and able to read, review and write Terraform Use AI coding agents in your daily work, and can show security tooling, tests or review checks you've built with them Understand the security risks that agents bring, including prompt injection, over-broad permissions and untrusted dependencies A developer-first outlook, where success looks like engineers choosing the secure option and owning their own security Clear communicator who can turn security risk into practical decisions for technical and non-technical colleagues We especially want to hear from you if you have: Built security guardrails for teams working with coding agents or automated software delivery Worked on software that serves many customers from shared infrastructure, and the data-separation questions that come with it Worked in a functional language such as Haskell, or built security checks for a language the standard tools cover poorly Worked in InsurTech, FinTech or another regulated industry Helped build security practices from an early stage Spent time training and coaching engineers on security Benefits Private medical insurance Income protection insurance
